Class NlsPayloadBuilder

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.nls.NlsPayloadBuilder
public final class NlsPayloadBuilder extends Object
Turns a flat set of raw NLS property entries into the structure delivered to the client, applying NlsKeyMapper to every key and rejecting any mapping that is not unique.

The result is a SortedMap rather than an arbitrary map on purpose. The payload is hashed into an ETag, is diffed against a checked-in baseline during the migration, and decides which of two colliding keys wins; all three need a deterministic iteration order, which a hash-based container does not provide.

    • validateNesting

      public static List<String> validateNesting(Set<String> rawKeys)
      Structural check of the nesting contract, without building a payload or touching the file system. Used by the build-time guard so that a violation is reported as a list rather than as the first exception thrown.

      Enforced invariants: a namespace name is never also used as a plain key (that would make the client read a string where it expects an object), and a nested key has exactly one segment below its namespace (a second level would require recursion and an escaping convention that this contract deliberately avoids).

      Parameters:
      rawKeys - the merged raw property keys to check
      Returns:
      one description per violation, empty when the contract holds
